Description:
As a student, I want to submit a chapter remotely so I can send my work without arranging a visit.
PP-01 / FR-01 / T-01
Given an assigned project and a new chapter
When the student uploads a valid file
Then version 1 appears with its submission timestamp.

As a supervisor, I want to open the latest chapter so I can review the correct file.
PP-02 / FR-02 / T-02
Given two versions of the same chapter
When the assigned supervisor opens the chapter
Then version 2 appears first and version 1 remains accessible.

Summary: US-03 Record corrections on a version
Description:
As a supervisor, I want to record corrections on a version so I can make the changes clear to the student.
PP-03 / FR-03 / T-03
Given a Submitted chapter version
When the assigned supervisor saves feedback and selects Changes requested
Then the feedback and decision appear on that version.

As a student, I want to resubmit a revised chapter so I can preserve the earlier review.
PP-02 / FR-04 / T-04
Given version 1 is marked Changes requested
When the student uploads a valid revision
Then version 2 is Submitted and version 1 retains its feedback.

As a student, I want to check review status so I can know whether my next action is due.
PP-04 / FR-05 / T-05
Given a chapter has been reviewed
When the student opens the project
Then the latest decision and its feedback are visible.

Summary: US-06 Share a specific GitHub update
Description:
As a student, I want to share a specific github update so I can direct my supervisor to the relevant change.
PP-05 / FR-06 / T-06
Given an assigned project and a valid GitHub commit link
When the student submits the link and a summary
Then the supervisor sees both in the project updates list.

Summary: US-07 Comment on a GitHub update
Description:
As a supervisor, I want to comment on a github update so I can record what the student should change.
PP-05 / FR-07 / T-07
Given a shared GitHub update
When the assigned supervisor saves a comment
Then the student sees the comment beside that link.

As a student, I want to filter my chapter list so I can find chapters that require action.
PP-04 / FR-08 / T-08
Given chapters with different statuses
When the student filters by Changes requested
Then only chapters with that status appear.
